overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the University of Florida men's basketball team, the Gators, for winning the 2025 NCAA national championship with a 65-63 victory over the University of Houston on April 7, 2025. It notes this was the program's third national title and its first under coach Todd Golden, and recognizes player Walter Clayton Jr., named the tournament's most outstanding player. It congratulates the school's fans, students and faculty and sends copies to university leaders. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on May 15, 2025.
for: Supporters say it honors a team's national championship and the pride it brings to the university and its state.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic: it does not change any law or spending.
